name: desktop-electron-specs-native
goal: Desktop test:e2e stays headless Chromium; every Electron-launching spec runs only through test:native

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: After merging main 8d779bc (PR 39) at c6c77ec, desktop test:e2e (chromium project) still takes game-native.spec.ts, whose fixture launches Electron via _electron. Main's contract: test:e2e launches no Electron app; Electron suites run only through test:native.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: packages/desktop/test/test-preview-refusal.test.ts checks project routing only for two named specs (native-desktop, ui-hosted), so an Electron spec added on a branch is never classified. Strengthen it to classify every tests/e2e spec by its own or local-fixture _electron use and require chromium to ignore, and native to match, exactly those.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red d52e370 record d7dbe83b2d07: strengthened refusal test fails 'chromium ignores game-native.spec.ts: expected false to be true'; preview-port refusal cases pass. Command: frozen install, desktop sync, vitest on test/test-preview-refusal.test.ts.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix 3ee370c: the native project pattern also takes game-native.spec.ts, so chromium ignores it; README names both Electron suites. Unchanged refusal test passes 3/3 locally. Sealed green refused: runner configuration is a frozen regression input.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
